text.characters: 2.2.1 Why is this learning unit is important?
Dementia can often make communication difficult.
How will this lesson help me?
This lesson helps you to talk in a simple and direct way and show your compassion in everyday situations.

•	To check the ability to hear and see
•	To get attention in a respectful way
•	To keep it simple
•	To take the person seriously
•	To pay attention to reactions
•	To give compliments
